notes.title: Changelog 1.2.8 - Online Lobbies & Upcoming Friend's Pass
notes.content:
[h2]Online Lobbies[/h2]

This update introduces a new feature providing support for global lobbies. You'll now be able to create and browse lobbies anyone can join, no matter which version of the game they own (e.g. the Friend's Pass, see below). These lobbies can either be private (i.e. invite-only) or public. Public lobbies will show up in the in-game server list.

[h2]Upcoming Friend's Pass[/h2]

In the coming days, the [b]Shenanigans Friend's Pass[/b] will be released, available on the steam store page. The Friend's Pass is free and will allow players who do not own the game to play with others that do own it. It supports both LAN and online lobbies, as described above. Due to technical limitations, Steam lobbies (i.e. inviting friends via Steam) are not supported for cross-play between the purchased version of the game and the Friend's Pass.

Hosting your own games, singleplayer mode and browsing public online lobbies are not available in the Friend's Pass and require the purchased full version of the game.

notes.title: Changelog 1.1.0 - Singleplayer & NPCs
notes.content:
Added a button to the main menu to create singleplayer games with 0 to 7 NPCs (1-8 total players).

[list]
[*] Playing without NPCs might result in unexpected/missing behavior for cards that interact with opponents. — [i]e.g. stealing coins from or giving dice to an opponent won't do anything.[/i]
[/list]

Added options in the lobby settings to change the behavior of NPCs.

[list]
[*] How often should NPCs play cards, if possible?
[*] Should NPCs primarily play cards favorable or unfavorable for themselves?
[*] Should NPCs always target the first, last or a random player when selecting opponents? 
[/list]

notes.title: Shenanigans: Full Release
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Shenanigans is now feature-complete and no longer in Early Access!

[h2]New Content[/h2]

With the full release of Shenanigans, we added a bunch of new cards for even more chaos and customizability!

[b]Event Cards[/b]
[list]
[*] "I Bet on Winning" - Triggers an action, when a jester adds a rule
[*] "A Give-and-Take" - Triggers an action, when a jester removes a rule
[*] "You've Changed" - Triggers an action, when a jester changes a rule
[*] "King of the Hill" - Triggers an action, when a jesters' placement improves
[*] "It’s All Downhill from Here" - Triggers an action, when a jester's placement reduces 
[/list]
[b]Shenanigans Cards[/b]
[list]
[*] "Welcome to the Exchange" - Switch all your coins with another jester
[*] "Gonna Get a Head Start" - Switch all your dice with another jester
[*] "See It as an Opportunity" - Switch all your cards with another jester
[*] "Another Round" - Throw your dice and move the resulting amount of spaces
[*] "Where… Where Am I?" - Shuffle all jester's positions randomly
[/list]
[b]Action Cards[/b]
[list]
[*] "Switcheroo" - Switch places with an opponent
[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

Shenanigans will continue to be updated for bug fixes, improvements and new content like cards cards, boards and accessories. However, the interval between updates might take longer than during the Early Access Phase as Benevoland will also focus on exploring new ideas in the world of game development in the future. Stay tuned!

- The Shenanigans Team

notes.title: Changelog 0.17.2 - New Cards & Game Preset Overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]Game Preset Overhaul[/h1]
[list]
[*] The editor for game presets has been revamped!
[*] Customize and create new cards, adjust their costs, titles and descriptions
[*] Fully customize the rarity of cards and card types
[*] Copy existing card packs and create custom ones for easy access and management
[*] Modify initial game rules
[*] Define default values for game length, action points per turn and board events
[/list]

[h2]New Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] "Divine Intervention" (3 AP) -- Add a random rule to the game
[*] "Future Me is Gonna Love Me" (X AP) -- Transfer X AP from this turn to your next turn
[*] "That's a Problem for Future Me" (0 AP) -- Transfer X AP from your next turn(s) to this turn
[/list]

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] When cards are merged to new rules or existing rules are being changed, the new rules will now be shown for a slightly longer period of time.
[/list]
